segments.iti9:2.1: “Lobhaṃ, bhikkhave, anabhijānaṃ aparijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ avirājayaṃ appajahaṃ abhabbo dukkhakkhayāya.
segments.iti9:2.2: Lobhañca kho, bhikkhave, abhijānaṃ parijānaṃ tattha cittaṃ virājayaṃ pajahaṃ bhabbo dukkhakkhayāyā”ti.
segments.iti9:3.5: Pahāya na punāyanti, imaṃ lokaṃ kudācanan”ti.
segments.iti9:4.1: Ayampi attho vutto bhagavatā, iti me sutanti.
